# Charmed [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#CharmedCondition)*

While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects.

***Can't Harm the Charmer.*** You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects.

***Social Advantage.*** The charmer has [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md) on any ability check to interact with you socially.
